name: אינטגרציה בחלקים – e^t·sin(t) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Integrate {{CT:0}} with respect to \(t\) using the method of integration by parts.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Integrate by parts twice; the original integral appears again, so solve the resulting equation for it.
Step 1 — First integration by parts
Integration by parts: \( \int u\,v'\,dx=uv-\int u'\,v\,dx \)
To solve this problem we will have to use the method of integration by parts two times as follows: Let \(u = {{CT:1}}\) and \(dv = {{CT:2}}dt\) so that \(du = {{CT:3}}dt\) and \(v = {{CT:4}}\). Then,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:5}} dt &= \int u dt \\ &= uv - \int v du \\ &= {{CT:1}}\cdot \left({{CT:4}}\right) - \int {{CT:4}}\cdot \left({{CT:3}}\right) dt + c \\ &= {{CT:6}} - \int {{CT:4}}\cdot \left({{CT:3}}\right) dt + c \end{aligned} \]

Step 2 — Second integration by parts
Now, define \(u = {{CT:3}}\) and \(dv = {{CT:4}}dt\) so that \(du = {{CT:7}}dt\) and \(v = {{CT:8}}\). Then,

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:4}}\cdot \left({{CT:3}}\right)dt &= \int u dt \\ &= uv - \int v du \\ &= {{CT:3}}\cdot \left({{CT:8}}\right) - \int {{CT:8}} [{{CT:7}}dt] \\ &= {{CT:9}} + \int {{CT:10}}dt. \end{aligned} \]

Step 3 — Solving for the integral
And so

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:5}} dt &= {{CT:6}} - \left[{{CT:9}} + \int {{CT:10}} d{{CT:11}}\right] + c \\ &= {{CT:6}} - {{CT:9}} - \int {{CT:10}} dt + c. \end{aligned} \]

Hence,

\[ \begin{aligned} 2\int {{CT:5}} dt &= {{CT:12}} + c \\ \int {{CT:5}} dt &= {{CT:13}} + k. \end{aligned} \]
